localDatabase.encryption: SQLCipher key is generated randomly and stored in device-only SecureStore; key is applied before any database read
localDatabase.sensitiveColumns: No passwords, access tokens, refresh tokens, session secrets, assessment answers or lesson bodies

conflictRules.mastery: Server projection always wins; never calculate locally
conflictRules.studyPlan: Server wins; reload on 409 before showing updated plan
conflictRules.lessonCompletion: Queueing is PENDING_SYNC only; server acknowledgement is required before authoritative completion
conflictRules.assessmentSubmission: ONLINE_ONLY; server attempt/version and idempotency rules win

datasets.name: published course metadata
datasets.currentState: Cached per authenticated user after successful /me/courses response
datasets.requirement: Authoritative Learning Service entitlement is checked before cache population

datasets.name: published lesson content and approved media references
datasets.requirement: Content remains online-only until an appropriate authorization-aware secure content design exists

datasets.name: last-synced Study Plan
datasets.currentState: Cached per authenticated user and course after successful live response
datasets.requirement: Display LIVE or OFFLINE_CACHE and LAST_SYNCED; successful live response always wins

datasets.name: last-synced Mastery
datasets.currentState: Cached per authenticated user and course after successful live response
datasets.requirement: Display LAST_SYNCED; never recalculate from offline activity

datasets.name: notification metadata
datasets.requirement: Avoid private lesson/assessment details in lock-screen payload

datasets.name: lesson completion operation
datasets.currentState: Persisted in SQLCipher; retry on reconnect with the same idempotency key
datasets.conflictPolicy: Server completion/version wins; re-read progress before retry

datasets.name: refresh credential and session secret
datasets.currentState: Device-only Keychain/Android Keystore SecureStore; never copied into SQLCipher or logs

datasets.name: password
datasets.currentState: Used only for the login request; never written to storage, logs or analytics

datasets.name: plaintext credentials and session secrets
datasets.currentState: Never written to AsyncStorage, ordinary SQLite, logs, analytics, URL parameters or clipboard

datasets.name: final grading, payment, credential issuance and security administration
